theme_identity.mode: Light mode primary. The aesthetic relies heavily on a warm, tinted cream background to allow the deep maroon and rich product colors to stand out. Do not implement a dark mode toggle as it breaks the luxury editorial feel.

font_families.accents: Playfair Display, serif (italicized for editorial touch)

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-normal tracking-tight leading-none text-maroon-900

colors.rules: Never use pure black #000000 or pure white #FFFFFF for backgrounds. Use tinted off-whites. Primary brand color (Maroon #5D101C) should be used for CTAs, Announcement bars, and Footer. Accent (Gold #C5A059) used sparingly for star ratings, thin borders, or highlights.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E8E1D9 for subtle section dividers and product cards. Avoid thick borders.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimalist approach. Use soft ambient shadows (shadow-sm or shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(93,16,28,0.05)]) only on hover states for product cards and floating navigation. No harsh or dark box-shadows.
visual_enhancers.textures: Include subtle grain or paper texture overlay on the hero section to kill 'digital flatness'.
visual_enhancers.radii: Sharp edges (rounded-none) for a high-fashion editorial look, except for circular categories (rounded-full) and minimal radiused tags/badges (rounded-sm).

components.announcement_bar: Bg-maroon (#5D101C), text-light, text-xs uppercase tracking-widest, centered. Can include a slow marquee if multiple texts.
components.header: Sticky top, bg-[#FBF9F6] with heavy opacity (no transparent header), 1px subtle bottom border. Logo centered or left, Navigation centered, Icons (Search, Wishlist, Cart) right. Use Lucide icons (stroke-width 1.5).
components.hero_carousel: Full-width or 95% inset with 1px border. Dark maroon overlay (bg-black/30) on images. H1 text centered, 'FESTIVE COLLECTION 2026', Primary CTA button (bg-maroon, text-white, hover:bg-maroon-light).
components.category_tiles: Circular (aspect-square, rounded-full), image object-cover. Text centered below, text-sm, tracking-wide. Image scales up slightly on hover.
components.product_card: aspect-[3/4] or aspect-[4/5] image wrapper, overflow-hidden. Image scale-105 on hover. Absolute positioned top-right Wishlist heart. Absolute top-left 'NEW' or 'SALE' badge (bg-maroon text-white text-xs px-2 py-1). Title left-aligned, price left-aligned with Gold/Maroon text.
components.buttons: Sharp rectangular (rounded-none). Primary: bg-maroon text-white hover:bg-[#7A1525]. Secondary: border border-maroon text-maroon hover:bg-maroon hover:text-white.
components.service_strip: 4-to-6 column grid. Minimalist stroke icons (lucide-react), text-sm font-medium.
components.festive_edit_cta: Split layout (image one side, text/CTA other side) or large image with offset text box (Bento style). High editorial feel.
components.newsletter: Card layout with solid Maroon background, Gold text accents, single input field and subscribe button.
components.footer: Deep Maroon background (#5D101C), light cream text (#FBF9F6). Generous padding (py-20). 4-column link layout.

grids_layouts.global_spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-16 or py-24 for main sections to give an editorial, premium breathing room.
grids_layouts.product_grid: grid-cols-2 on mobile, md:grid-cols-3, lg:grid-cols-4. gap-4 md:gap-8.
grids_layouts.bento_features: Use a staggered or asymmetric grid for the 'Why Choose Us' or 'Festive Edit' section to break monotony.
grids_layouts.instagram_feed: grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4, gap-0 or gap-1 (edge-to-edge images).

motion.hover_states: Product images scale-105 smoothly (transition-transform duration-500 ease-out). Buttons and links change color with 200ms transition.
motion.scroll_reveals: Use Framer Motion to stagger-fade-up product cards as they enter the viewport. Do not over-animate.
motion.marquee: Slow, smooth drift for the announcement bar or a text-based brand ribbon.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has sufficient contrast using gradients or text-shadows.
accessibility.aria_labels: All icon buttons (cart, wishlist, arrows) must have aria-labels.
accessibility.test_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-button').

media.image_style: Editorial, warm tones, high contrast. Authentic Indian ethnic wear models, close-ups on textures.

hero_banners.description: Woman in red and blue sari portrait (Use for main hero)

festive_edit.description: Woman in blue dress sitting on grass (Use for Festive Edit CTA)

textures.description: Orange and yellow flowers (Use for subtle festive background accent if needed)

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for structural and marketing layouts. Avoid Shadcn for large marketing sections to maintain asymmetry and custom styling.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: For interactive elements (dropdowns, sheet for mobile menu, carousel), use Shadcn UI but heavily customize the borders, radii, and colors to match the luxury theme.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Implement Playfair Display for headings and Manrope for body text.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: Ensure the Announcement bar, Header, Hero section, Category Grid, Product Grid, Festive CTA, Why Choose Us, Insta Feed, Reviews, Newsletter, and Footer are strictly implemented as requested.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Do NOT use placeholder images. Use the precise URLs provided in the image_urls section.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Never apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions (transition-colors, transition-transform).
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Do not use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons. Use lucide-react.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Include data-testid on all interactive elements for robust automated testing.
